name: Creamy Baked Fish over Potato Gratin

components.name: Creamy Fish and Potato Gratin

ingredients.name: Raw skinless boneless white fish fillets
Raw peeled starchy potatoes, sliced thin
Vegetable stock instead of white wine

steps: Preheat oven to 180 C. Cut potatoes into evenly thin slices, rinsing and draining them to prevent discolouration.
Melt butter in a wide ovenproof skillet, soften leek and garlic, then add potatoes and stir over medium heat for several minutes.
Add stock and allow to reduce slightly, then pour in cream and bring to a gentle simmer; spread potatoes into an even layer.
Season fish fillets and rest them on top of the potato mixture, pressing gently.
Combine breadcrumbs, parmesan and olive oil and scatter evenly over fish and gratin.
Bake about 25-35 minutes until potatoes are fully tender, fish reaches 63 C and crumb top is golden. Divide into four portions.

Planning: SECONDARY STOVETOP: leek and potato base before oven bake.

Dietary: Contains fish, wheat and dairy.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.

flags.shelfLife: Fish — plan for days 1-3; the cream can separate if frozen.
